title: Fix Save Profile error and banner button functionality

requirements.text: Fix the 'failed to update profile' error that occurs when a user taps the Save button in the Edit Profile modal. The backend profile update call must succeed and persist changes (name, handle, bio, location, profile photo) correctly.

quotes: whenn tap the button of save profile it write failed to update profile try again

acceptanceCriteria: Tapping Save in the Edit Profile modal sends a valid update request to the backend actor
Profile changes (name, handle, bio, location) are persisted and reflected after saving
No 'failed to update profile' error is shown after a successful save
Error handling is graceful if the backend call genuinely fails

requirements.text: Fix the banner upload/change button on the profile page so it is fully functional. Users must be able to tap the banner button, select an image, and have it displayed as the profile banner.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the banner button opens a file picker
Selecting an image uploads and displays it as the profile banner
The banner is persisted in the backend and visible after page reload

constraints: Use existing code and patterns already in the codebase — do not rewrite components from scratch
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui
nonGoals: Adding new profile fields beyond what already exists
Any other profile-related features not explicitly mentioned
